import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static long power(long a, long b) {
        long ans = 1;
        long mod = 1000000007;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) {
                ans = (ans * a) % mod;
            }
            a = (a * a) % mod;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static boolean prime(int n) {
        if (n < 2) return false;
        for (int i = 2; i * i <= n; i++) {
            if (n % i == 0) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = sc.next();
        int n = s.length();
        StringBuilder s1 = new StringBuilder();
        s1.append(s.charAt(0));
        int i = 1;
        while (i < n) {
            if (i + 2 < n && s.charAt(i) == 'd' && s.charAt(i + 1) == 'o' && s.charAt(i + 2) == 't') {
                s1.append('.');
                i += 3;
            } else {
                s1.append(s.charAt(i));
                i++;
            }
        }
        String s1Str = s1.toString();
        int m = s1Str.length();
        StringBuilder s2 = new StringBuilder();
        s2.append(s1Str.charAt(0));
        boolean b = true;
        i = 1;
        while (i < m) {
            if (b && i + 1 < m && s1Str.charAt(i) == 'a' && s1Str.charAt(i + 1) == 't') {
                s2.append('@');
                i += 2;
                b = false;
            } else {
                s2.append(s1Str.charAt(i));
                i++;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(s2.toString());
        sc.close();
    }
}
